key_idea: Do the cutting one step at a time and keep track of each colour.
steps: First cut: red and yellow are cut. 4 red become 8. 3 yellow become 6. The 2 blue stay 2.
Second cut: yellow and blue are halved. 6 yellow become 12. 2 blue become 4. The 8 red stay 8.

choice_feedback.A: 16 pieces is only after the first cut. The second cut adds more.
choice_feedback.B: The second cut halves 6 yellow and 2 blue pieces, so it adds 8 pieces, not 2.
choice_feedback.C: The second cut adds 8 pieces, not 4.
choice_feedback.D: The second cut adds 8 pieces, not 6. Do not forget the blue pieces.
